Slight change to this idea:

Make sure comments you post start out with your own upvote, as it does on reddit.

Humans are spiteful creatures, and regardless of what you want upvotes and downvotes to represent, they will be used as disagreement. This means any kind of heated discussion between two users is just going to end up ruining their karma as they downvote each other and get -1 for each comment. So comments should have the commenter's +1 vote already on them by default.
